Hanno Tourism Information Center Omiyage Shop Yume-uma will close from April 1, 2026 (Reiwa 8).

Souvenir sales end March 13, 2026 (Friday). Tourism information services and use of the adjacent public restroom end March 31, 2026 (Tuesday).

Souvenir sales will continue at Hanno Station Tourism Information Center Puratto Hanno. That facility will be closed April 1–10, 2026 for renovation. From April 2026, hours will change to 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. on weekdays and weekends/holidays alike.
summary: ℹ️ Closure Notice: Hanno Tourism Information Center Omiyage Shop Yume-uma
